Gaya Ji Pind Daan: Kya Kisi Bhi Din Kar Sakte Hain? | Ya Sirf Pitru Paksha Mein?
Can Pind Daan in Gaya Ji be performed on any day of the year, or is it strictly limited to Pitru Paksha? Discover the authentic rules, scriptural references, and guidelines from the Vayu Purana (Gaya Mahatmya) regarding Gaya Shradh and ancestral rites.
